elements.name: long-distance bus station in Addis Ababa
very long queue of people winding toward ticket window
two young men near end of queue seen from behind

wrong_setting: Reads as an East Asian train or subway concourse: the hanging signs carry pseudo-Chinese/Japanese characters, the crowd looks East Asian, and there are no buses, no ticket window and nothing Ethiopian.
notes: Repaint as an Addis Ababa bus station with a long queue leading to a small ticket window, and remove all signage text. Show the shorter man from behind, not facing camera, as an Ethiopian youth beside his taller denim-jacketed companion near the end of the queue.
